title: Longest Common Signal
description: Given two strings, find the length of their longest subsequence that appears in both strings while preserving the relative order of characters.
constraints: 1 <= n,m <= 1000; both strings contain lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: First line: first string. Second line: second string.
outputFormat: Print the length of the longest common subsequence.
hints: When the current characters match, extend the diagonal result. Otherwise keep the better result from skipping one character.

examples.explanation: The longest common subsequence is ace.
One longest common subsequence is one.
